text: FindRequest compares source support and the direct destination using SameCOMIdentity. Its folder-copy fallback reads the destination's parent and compares that parent pointer with the queued destination; a server destination skips the parent check. Preserve these exact branches instead of describing every comparison as a leaf-name or normalized interface-identity check. The listed source establishes structural matching, with no proxy-identity or concurrent-copy experiment. Static source and test inspection only. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.
title: Match copy completion by interface identity and destination ownership
